knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: CN-R1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. For observations (xi, yi), what criterion defines ordinary least squares estimates?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: OLS minimises residual sum of squares for the specified model form.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Minimise squared vertical differences between observed and fitted responses.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Minimising fitted values or requiring exact interpolation.

choices.label: Choose coefficients that minimise the sum over i of (yi minus fitted yi) squared.
Choose coefficients that minimise the sum of fitted responses squared.
Choose coefficients that maximise sample correlation in every regression.
Choose coefficients that make every residual zero regardless of parameter count.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: CN-R1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Stepwise selection produces a linear model with high R-squared, but its residual plot shows clear curvature. What is the best conclusion?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Residual curvature indicates an inadequate mean structure; selection criteria do not replace diagnostics.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Reconsider the functional form and validate a justified revised specification.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Assuming automated selection or high R-squared establishes adequacy.

choices.label: The mean structure is likely misspecified, so investigate justified transformations or nonlinear terms and validate the revised model.
High R-squared proves the linear functional form is adequate.
Variable selection guarantees unbiased coefficients and valid inference.
Delete observations on one side of the curve until residuals look flat.
